map.公式法误差较大，仅作趋势参考；较准方法为皮褶厚度、生物电阻抗(BIA)、DXA（: The formula method has a fairly large error and is only a trend reference; more accurate methods are skinfold thickness, bioelectrical impedance (BIA) and DXA (dual-energy X-ray). People with a lot of muscle get their body fat overestimated.
map.医疗健康类结果为按公式得到的估算值，不能替代医生诊断与处方。给药剂量、补液速度、: Results in the medical category are estimates obtained from formulas and cannot replace a doctor's diagnosis or prescription. Dosage, infusion rate, anticoagulation and thrombolysis decisions must follow the drug label, clinical guidelines and the attending physician. Seek immediate care for chest pain, breathing difficulty, altered consciousness or other emergencies.
map.同 BMI 下男性基础脂肪低于女性，公式用 −10.8（男）/0（女）修正性别差: At the same BMI the essential fat is lower in men than in women, so the formula corrects for sex with −10.8 (male) / 0 (female); healthy body fat is normally higher in women.
map.男女公式为何不同？: Why do the formulas for men and women differ?

map.输入身高、体重、年龄与性别，使用 Deurenberg 公式估算体脂率，提供身体: Enter height, weight, age and sex to estimate body fat percentage with the Deurenberg formula, giving a rough body composition reference for tracking body fat during fat loss (rough estimate only).
map.：算法（Deurenberg）：体脂% = 1.2×BMI + 0.23×年龄: : algorithm (Deurenberg): body fat % = 1.2 x BMI + 0.23 x age - 10.8 x (1 for men, 0 for women) - 5.4; BMI = weight / height^2. All values must be > 0. This is a rough estimate with about +/-3.5% error.
